description: Unsets nomatch and equals so zsh passes an unmatched glob or an =word through as written, as bash does, and explains zsh errors in the result

hooks.command: [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || grep -qs 'unsetopt nomatch' "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" || echo 'if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then unsetopt nomatch equals; fi' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"
